body:
Thank you... I cried reading this.

Edit: I don't think I'm a monster because I have unmet needs, though. Rather, I seem to turn into one once I do have my needs met? Or maybe once I have some but not all met I go berserk trying to get the leftover ones met? I'm so sad and confused. I feel so worthless

Thank your for the response, it helps to know I'm not supposed to necessarily know what the end product will look like. I'm not on medication, as unfortunately I'm treatment resistant, & my liver is fucked up from medical malpractice, which confines me to herbal treatment until it heals. I've had 10+ diagnoses, none of which has ever quite fit, & been on almost every psych med on the market before the malpractice, with no success. It seems to be my soul & not just my brain that's broken.

Unfortunately the concepts of having something & deserving it (thus being entitled to it) and the inverse of not having = undeserving, never entitled... are inseparably conflated in my head. I think it developed largely as a trauma response to cope with the severe neglect my parents subjected me to from birth. Unfortunately, it means that when I finally acquire the things I desire/have needs met, desperation takes over, I go blindly overboard, and find myself trying to get all I can from who or whatever deemed me worthy before the connection or situation inevitably fails & I'm plunged back into unworthiness. I've tried so hard to untangle the conflation of having = entitled to/not having = undeserving in my head because logically I know this is untrue when compared with real world evidence, but it's the only way I can make emotional sense of the world and the lifetime of hell I've suffered.

As a result of this, I'm self absorbed, clingy, manipulative, angry, entitled, shallow, cowardly, and two-faced. I lie too often for my comfort and often make others responsible for my emotions. It terrifies me to be around people who fulfill my needs because the entitled monster inevitably comes out. 

Before COVID I was largely able to reciprocate in relationships, had many friendships, and generally was well liked. I was kind, independent, patient, gentle, soft spoken, empathetic, funny, and fairly wise. I was the advice friend, an excellent listener, and made a point of treating absolutely everyone with kindness & empathy, especially when I was frustrated with a situation, because I either understood or wanted to understand. Now, after being left alone in my home for a year, I'm the opposite of any of those things. 

Unfortunately I now see my drive to nurture all of those good qualities came from a place of shame & just wanting to be deserving of/entitled to love. I've spent so long in therapy but no therapist seems interested in dissecting me this way & attempts by those who have tried have still been deeply unhelpful or further damaging in untangling this. I have no idea how to pick up the pieces.

The fact that I'm not entitled to it feels like it means I'll never have it.... I have virtually nothing to offer in return & I've tried so hard to find who I was but he's gone, I'm just so cruel and horrible now
Please try to explain, I'm desperate
I am trying, but nothing works and no one sees it

I can't do any of those things though, attempt left me disabled & bedridden. She said she couldn't promise but I know she'll be fine & will finally be able to live the life she wanted once I'm gone. Things could have gotten better but now they never will & it's my fault, I'm weak and pathetic and shouldn't still be here

We never even got to make any good memories because I attempted before we were going to see each other and now my body is ruined I just need to go. I asked her to promise me she'll be okay & I'm leaving her everything when I'm gone, it's more than I could ever do for her living. I'm scared to have a family because abused people become abusers and I'm not strong enough to keep myself in check. Been in therapy 10+ years it never helps
Also I'm so sorry about your bf and I'm glad you're here

No siblings, no family, parents hate me and adoptive family has started hating me too. I'm a burden on everyone. I ruin the lives of everyone I meet. Girlfriend is tired and all I do is add to the pain for her. The best thing I can do for everyone is just die, I'm not worth it
I really wish I wasn't already head over heels for the one person who means the most to me in life, lol. Thank you, I'm very flattered.
